{{Top|leg}}
A '''remote receiver''' was a device installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] so that they could be controlled via a [[remote processor]] rather than by internal [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

They were also used at [[Hapan]] [[Honor duel]]ling to recognize a connecting blow and allow for a referee to note the score and, at the referee's discretion, decide whether the match went into a sudden death stipulation.<ref name="NOJ>The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse</ref>
